other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Feature Selection
other_failure_modes.description: The validation set is used iteratively to evaluate and select features in a greedy forward search. This leaks validation information into the modeling pipeline, resulting in an overly optimistic validation score.

summary: The agent successfully avoids major data leakage between the train and test sets, implementing feature selection, feature engineering, and scaling correctly after splitting. However, the solution fails to perform any basic data cleaning, uses a naive majority vote for ensembling, and evaluates stochastic models only once. Additionally, the agent leaks the validation data into the feature selection process by using the validation split to iteratively evaluate candidate features.
